newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Short-end Swedish debt yields fall as crown gains.
newsitem.headline: Short-end Swedish debt yields fall as crown gains.

text.p: Swedish short term debt yields inched down on the stronger crown and on hopes for more Riksbank rate cuts.

"The crown has firmed against the mark along with the dollar, but commercial interests to buy crowns have also played their part," one dealer said. "I think the crown will firm to 4.35 against the mark at the most," he added.

Six-month T-bill rates fell one basis point to 4.26 percent and ten-year bond yields were flat at 7.11 percent. The spread between three- and ten year bond yields increased by three basis points to 197.
The crown firmed to 4.3615 against the mark compared to 4.3690 late on Wednesday.
